status: exploratory, not pre-registered (ADR-081, updated ADR-088, ADR-090, ADR-092)
mechanism: Investigated directly (ADR-090): a generic lexical-overlap property of dense retrieval (bare notices are near-identical to a question written about the same paper), not a finding about supersession or notice informativeness. See results/notice_length_mechanism.md.

bare_notice_summary.note: bare is not a sufficient condition for ranking above the trap source; consistent with a continuous length effect, not a threshold at the bare/non-bare boundary.

method: notice_length_chars = len(f"Notice: {title}" + " " + (notice_text or "")), matching corpus/embed_index.py's exact indexed text.
note: Post-hoc: hypothesis generated by inspecting RB-0007/RB-0008 (ADR-077), then re-tested against a growing sample including RB-0011 and RB-0013, both bare, on opposite sides of the pattern. Not an independent confirmation. See ADR-081, ADR-088, ADR-090, ADR-092, and results/notice_length_correlation.md.
